extracted.name: Dump and Bake Mini Rolls
extracted.description: Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 30 minutes Rest Time: 1 hour Total Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
instruction_lines: In a bowl, combine all-purpose flour, yeast, salt and sugar.
Add in warm water and olive oil. Mix with a spatula until no dry flour remains.
Using wet hands, pull one corner of dough up and fold over itself.
Turn bowl 45 degrees and repeat 8 times total.
Cover with plastic wrap and place in a warm spot to rise for 1 hour.
Heavily flour a surface and dump risen dough out. Flour the top and cut into 6 equal pieces with a knife or bench scraper.
Transfer pieces directly onto a floured, parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake at 440°F for 30 minutes until golden brown.
